newsitem.title: JAPAN: Big Japan trust banks put Nomura Sec deals on hold.
newsitem.headline: Big Japan trust banks put Nomura Sec deals on hold.

text.p: Five of Japan's big trust banks confirmed on Wednesday they have joined in moves in the financial industry to stop business dealings with Nomura Securities Co Ltd due to a scandal over suspected illegal deals.

Officials at five major trust banks -- Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp, Chuo Trust & Banking Co Ltd, Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd, Nippon Trust Bank Ltd and Yasuda Trust & Banking Co Ltd -- said they have suspended business dealings with Nomura.
Officials at Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd were not immediately available for comment.

On Monday, two Nomura directors resigned after the brokerage firm said they made apparently illegal deals and funnelled funds to a corporate client which has been linked by Japanese media to a former "sokaiya" racketeer.

Major Japanese asset management firms, including Nomura's own unit Nomura Investment Management Co, have suspended business with Nomura Securities since the brokerage disclosed the suspected illegal deals.
Non-financial Nomura clients are nervously awaiting the outcome of the SESC's probe, but they have stopped short of saying they are considering suspending business with it.
